License: MIT (see COPYING-battleboat.txt)

The UI is rewritten for GifOS (no Google Fonts, no image assets, no
localStorage, no alert). The computer is Bill Mei's probability AI —
opening book, hunt-around-hits weighting, remaining-ship placements —
running on this device.

Multiplayer is GifOS: each person writes only their own shots and the
revealed cells of their own fleet. Ship positions never leave this device.
